title: Control characters, escapes, astral-plane text and a long string all survive intact
rationale: The character-level floor of the value domain and the second good-input arm. Every field is a place a naive implementation loses data. The library has a hand-rolled escaper that handles only five characters and would mangle NUL; this fixture establishes that the default path does not reach it.
catchesBugClass: Hand-rolled escaping replacing Jackson anywhere on the scalar path; truncation of long values; surrogate-pair splitting; and double-unescaping of backslash sequences.
cannotCatch: The long field is only ~220 characters, far below the 1,000,000 threshold that is the sole length-sensitive branch. It also cannot catch encoding-level loss, since the oracle compares Java Strings and Maps rather than bytes.

predicted.detail: Jackson decodes every escape on the way in and re-escapes correctly on the way out; the surrogate pair stays paired. MapFlattener.escapeString is never reached.
